source_text: Peccata morte punita — separatio a vita Deo. Mors animae. Elige vitam. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Sins by-death punished — separation from life to-God. Death of-soul. Choose life. Amen.
pass_b_english: Sins punished by death mean separation from life with God — the soul’s death. [[Choose life >> Bible:Deuteronomy 30:19]]. Homilia XI CLOSEOUT. Amen.
